items.q: And I said, "well, I'll have a game with you". So we was having this game and it was crowded.

ctx.x: And there was a girl singer here. Her name was Helen. What was Helen's last name? Anyway, she was a big, heavyset girl and she sang good. And she had an apartment over there, on 43rd Street. And she said, "Helen, come on and have a game with me, cause they come to your games cause they think you have a lot of money and they come to you". And I said, "well, I'll have a game with you". So we was having this game and it was crowded. We had tables in all the rooms and everything. We had a big crowd. After awhile we…
